name: n019_condscl
purpose: Controlled target-speaker conditioning-strength screen at 1.5x and 2.0x against the already measured formal 1.0x result.
stop_conditions: counts differ from WER 1496 or UTMOS/WhiSQA 1934
failure: 1147683 stopped in 32 seconds because the 1,158-key full embedding archive did not exactly match the 843 test target-speaker keys. No WAV or metric was produced. Retry 1147832 uses the validated 843-key subset.
decision: Direct 1.5x inference increased W-NT privacy but failed quality by about -0.47 UTMOS and -0.35 WhiSQA. The job was stopped before 2.0x because the failure is monotonic in out-of-distribution conditioning strength.
decision_rule: Do not resubmit 1147683 or 1147832. A scale is only eligible if it preserves UTMOS/WhiSQA within 0.05 and does not regress WER by more than 0.25 pp versus formal. Eligible scales then need full LS360 E-VPC S.
